$comment: THE list of API keys the board knows about — read by the server (server/secrets.mjs: only these names can be saved), the board's API keys dialog (src/lib/apiKeys.ts) and tests/test_api_keys.py (every key must be read by something). Values are stored beside it in setup/.env (git-ignored, docker-ignored, never served). 'secret: false' values (URLs) are shown in full; secrets are masked.

services.name: Jira
services.why: Pulls every ticket on the board. Without it nothing can be fetched.
services.getIt: Jira → Profile → Personal Access Tokens → Create token

keys.label: Base URL
keys.hint: Leave empty to use endpoints.jiraBase from the config.

services.name: Bitbucket
services.why: Adds real branches, pull requests and review state to the cards.
services.getIt: Bitbucket → Personal settings → HTTP access tokens (read scope is enough)

keys.label: Atlassian token (alternative)
keys.hint: Used only when no HTTP access token is set.

keys.label: Base URL
keys.hint: Leave empty to use endpoints.bitbucketBase from the config.

services.name: Confluence
services.why: Lets the agent fallback read linked Confluence pages. The normal fetch does not need it.
services.getIt: Confluence → Profile → Personal Access Tokens → Create token

keys.label: Base URL
keys.hint: Leave empty to use endpoints.confluenceBase from the config.

services.name: Claude
services.why: Runs Cloud AI with Claude models, billed to this key's Anthropic account.

services.name: Cursor
services.why: Runs Cloud AI with Cursor models, and the default agent fallback when the fast fetch fails.

services.name: Gemini
services.why: Runs Cloud AI with Gemini models, billed to this key's Google account.

services.name: OpenAI
services.why: Only for the agent fallback when the codex connector is the active one.
